title: [Bug] [Dev/Master] Temp Profile switch on AAPSClient with duration, reduced % and Activity TT doesn't activate properly on AAPS (Only NSClientV1)
symptom: When using NSClientV1 sync, selecting a profile switch on AAPSClient with duration, reduced %, and Activity TT does not activate properly on AAPS. In dev, TT is set on both but temp profile switch is not carried out on AAPS; in master, TT is not set on AAPS but profile switch is set. Works fine with NSClientV3.
cause: NS deduping was blocking records, preventing the profile switch from being processed on AAPS when sent from AAPSClient.
fix: The issue was resolved by increasing the deduping delay to 10 seconds (commit 11da18ea85579cf3626d8f5539d6d02d4410cfaf).
evidence_quote: increased to 10s now working from AAPS client (at least for me)
